# Virafold

> Virafold (virafold.ai) is a creator business OS for faceless creators. It turns one long-form input — a transcript, script, podcast, or video — into a complete set of ready-to-post assets (short-form clip scripts for YouTube Shorts/TikTok/Instagram Reels, LinkedIn carousels, email newsletters, X threads), then schedules them on a content calendar, grows an owned email audience, and tracks revenue and brand deals. Tagline: "One idea, folded into everything."

## What Virafold does

- Idea backlog with hook-potential scoring; one click writes a full long-form script, another generates the multi-format asset set.
- Clip Studio: AI finds the most clippable moments in an uploaded video — chosen to match the creator's own proven winners from their audit and post metrics — then renders 1080x1920 vertical clips with burned-in captions (three caption styles) and schedules them straight to YouTube Shorts or TikTok.
- A/B hook testing: one click clones any asset with an alternate hook; both variants are scheduled and real platform metrics decide the winner, which then steers future generations.
- Brand voice profiles: tone, audience, default CTA, hashtags, banned words, and emoji policy are enforced on every generation.
- Performance flywheel: real post metrics flow back automatically from connected X and YouTube accounts (manual entry also supported); proven top-performing hooks are automatically fed into future generations as exemplars. A weekly operator brief email summarizes what won, what is queued, and revenue.
- Scheduling: a month-view content calendar with a background scheduler that delivers due posts, plus evergreen recycling (top assets automatically re-queue after each publish).
- Owned audience: subscriber list with import/export, a hosted link-in-bio page (virafold.ai/c/[handle]), an auto-generated media kit with sponsorship rates (virafold.ai/kit/[handle]), and newsletter broadcasts.
- Business management: a revenue ledger by income stream and a brand-deal pipeline (lead → negotiating → booked → delivered → paid); paid deals book themselves into the ledger.
- Trust rails: every generated asset carries a cryptographically signed, C2PA-shaped provenance manifest (source hash, engine, edit trail) and a pre-publish policy/demonetization lint.
- Localized end-to-end in 19 languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Korean, Arabic, Hindi, Russian, Italian, Indonesian, Turkish, Vietnamese, Dutch, Polish, and Thai.

## Who it is for

Faceless creators are the flagship segment, and the same system serves podcasters (diarized interview clipping), coaches and consultants, course creators, and agencies — creator-type presets configure the workspace per segment, and caption position + crop focus options make clips work for on-camera and talking-head formats too.

## Facts

- Product name: Virafold (formerly EchoForge Studio)
- Free tier available; paid plans with monthly generation allowances
- Works without connecting any AI keys (built-in engine); upgrades to Claude/GPT quality when keys are connected
- Contact: hello@virafold.ai
